title: cypripedium calceolus var. parviflorum
intro: Cypripedium calceolus var. parviflorum, commonly known as the small-flowered lady's slipper, is a type of orchid species that belongs to the Cypripedium genus. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Cypripedium calceolus var. parviflorum include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
